title: Design System: SF Vibe Lab Donation Site

display.purpose: Campaign headline on the yellow wall and the unavailable sign; uppercase, carries the painted shadow.

headline-numeral.purpose: Raised amount in yellow on the añil band; tabular figures.

headline-gap.purpose: "FALTAN $X" in cal on añil, close in size to the numeral.

title.purpose: Uppercase section signs: Elige tu donativo, Para qué es, Gracias.

label-sign.purpose: The SF Vibe Lab · Mérida signature in the wall corner.

lead.purpose: Campaign purpose opening the story column; Lexend 700.

body.purpose: All running text and supporter rows; story capped near 68ch.

small.purpose: Helper lines, donate notice, preview strip and footer.

shadows.name: painted-sombra
shadows.purpose: Flat two-coat sign-painter shadow on display lettering only. The system has no box shadows.

motion.name: brush-wipe
motion.purpose: Almagre coat wiped left to right onto the selected amount tile.

motion.name: sign-repaint
motion.purpose: Donate sign hover repaint (enamel to añil).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion every transition completes instantly.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Below this (max-width) amount tiles drop from 4 to 2 columns.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: From this (min-width) the page splits into content plus a 360–420px sticky donate column on the yellow wall.

lines.name: line
lines.purpose: Outline for tiles, donate board, meter (cal on añil), bill frame and the top of the thanks list.

focus.name: focus-default
focus.purpose: Default focus ring on cal and yellow grounds.

focus.name: focus-on-dark
focus.purpose: Focus ring on añil or enamel grounds (inside the band). The ring follows the ground it is drawn on, not the element.

components.name: Donate Sign
components.description: Full-width enamel slab lettered in yellow; repaints with the chosen amount.
components.css: .ds-sign-button { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 3.75rem; padding: 0.9rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--enamel, #15120e); color: var(--izamal, #e6a71c); font: 400 clamp(1.35rem, 5vw, 1.6rem)/1 var(--sign, 'Bungee', 'Lexend', sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-sign-button:hover { background: var(--anil, #1f2f6b); } .ds-sign-button:active { background: var(--almagre, #b23a1e); color: var(--cal, #f6f1e7); } .ds-sign-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--anil, #1f2f6b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Amount Tiles
components.description: Square painted amount tiles in a radio group; the chosen one is wiped almagre left to right.
components.css: .ds-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-tile { position: relative; isolation: isolate; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 0; border: 2px solid var(--enamel, #15120e); border-radius: 0; background: var(--cal, #f6f1e7); color: var(--enamel, #15120e); font: 400 1rem/1 var(--sign, 'Bungee', 'Lexend', sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tile span { position: relative; } .ds-tile::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -2px; z-index: -1; background: var(--almagre, #b23a1e); clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); transition: clip-path 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tile:hover:not([aria-checked='true']) { background: var(--cal-deep, #ece4d4); } .ds-tile[aria-checked='true'] { color: var(--cal, #f6f1e7); border-color: var(--almagre, #b23a1e); } .ds-tile[aria-checked='true']::before { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--anil, #1f2f6b); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Painted Sign Headline
components.description: Display lettering in añil on the yellow wall with the flat two-coat sombra.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-wall { background: var(--izamal, #e6a71c); color: var(--enamel, #15120e); padding: 1.25rem clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3rem) 3.75rem; } .ds-signature { display: block; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; font: 400 0.9375rem/1.2 var(--sign, 'Bungee', sans-serif); } .ds-sign { margin: 0; font: 400 clamp(2.5rem, 7.2vw, 6rem)/0.98 var(--sign, 'Bungee', sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--anil, #1f2f6b); text-shadow: 0.05em 0.05em 0 var(--cal, #f6f1e7), 0.1em 0.1em 0 var(--enamel, #15120e); text-wrap: balance; } .ds-wall-line { margin: 1rem 0 0; max-width: 34ch; font: 700 clamp(1rem, 1.6vw, 1.3rem)/1.45 var(--read, 'Lexend', sans-serif); color: var(--on-izamal-muted, #4a3a14); }

components.name: Progress Band
components.description: Añil band with the raised numeral, goal line, flat meter, and the missing amount lettered as boldly.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-band { background: var(--anil, #1f2f6b); color: var(--cal, #f6f1e7); padding: 1.25rem clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 3rem) 1.5rem; } .ds-band p { margin: 0; } .ds-band-raised { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.25rem 0.9rem; } .ds-numeral { font: 400 clamp(2.4rem, 5.5vw, 3.75rem)/1 var(--sign, 'Bungee', sans-serif); color: var(--izamal, #e6a71c); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-band-of { color: var(--on-anil-muted, #d9d2c3); font: 400 1rem/1.4 var(--read, 'Lexend', sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-meter { margin: 0.9rem 0 0.75rem; height: 1.25rem; border: 2px solid var(--cal, #f6f1e7); overflow: hidden; } .ds-meter-paint { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--izamal, #e6a71c); transform-origin: left center; } .ds-gap { font: 400 clamp(2rem, 4.6vw, 3.25rem)/1 var(--sign, 'Bungee', sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cal, #f6f1e7); }

components.name: Donate Board
components.description: Cal board with a 2px enamel outline hung on the yellow wall (desktop); holds the tiles and the donate sign.
components.html:
Elige tu donativo

Pesos mexicanos · mínimo $50 · pago seguro con tarjeta
components.css: .ds-board-wall { background: var(--izamal, #e6a71c); padding: 2rem; } .ds-board { max-width: 400px; background: var(--cal, #f6f1e7); border: 2px solid var(--enamel, #15120e); border-radius: 0; padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.25rem; color: var(--enamel, #15120e); } .ds-title { margin: 0; font: 400 clamp(1.25rem, 2.4vw, 1.6rem)/1.1 var(--sign, 'Bungee', sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-help { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; font: 400 0.875rem/1.45 var(--read, 'Lexend', sans-serif); color: var(--weather-2, #5a5045); }

components.css: .ds-thanks { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: 40rem; border-top: 2px solid var(--enamel, #15120e); font: 400 1.0625rem/1.6 var(--read, 'Lexend', sans-serif); background: var(--cal, #f6f1e7); } .ds-thanks li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.8rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cal-deep, #ece4d4); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-thanks li[data-age='0'] { color: var(--enamel, #15120e); font-weight: 700; } .ds-thanks li[data-age='1'] { color: var(--weather-1, #3b342c); } .ds-thanks li[data-age='2'] { color: var(--weather-2, #5a5045); } .ds-thanks li[data-age='3'] { color: var(--weather-3, #6e6356); }

components.name: Bill Photo Frame
components.description: Campaign photo pasted on the wall like a bill: 16:9, 2px enamel frame, square.
components.css: .ds-bill { margin: 0; max-width: 640px; border: 2px solid var(--enamel, #15120e); background: var(--cal, #f6f1e7); } .ds-bill-img { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: var(--cal-deep, #ece4d4); }

narrative.overview:
The site is a hand-painted shop sign on a lime-washed Mérida wall. Whole sections are painted as flat walls of colour (Izamal yellow, añil blue, black enamel) on a cal ground, and the campaign is lettered across them in big sign-painter capitals.

Everything is flat: no gradients, no blur, no rounded cards, no box shadows. Depth comes only from overlapping coats: the añil band climbs onto the yellow wall, the cal donate board hangs on it, the photo is pasted on like a bill. Almagre red is held back for the single thing in motion, the amount just chosen.

Density is low and type is large, because most visitors are relatives on phones. Display lettering is loud; everything read sits in calm, legible Lexend.
keyCharacteristics: Flat coats of colour as sections; depth only by overlap.
Bungee sign capitals for display, painted shadow on the headline only.
Lexend for all reading text, with a plain zero so amounts read as money.
Square corners and 2px enamel outlines everywhere.
Almagre red only on the selected or pressed element.
What is missing is lettered as boldly as what was raised.

rules.name: The One Moving Colour Rule
rules.body: Almagre appears only on the element in motion: the selected amount, a pressed sign, a selection, or a form error the donor has to fix. If nothing is chosen or wrong, nothing is red.

rules.name: The Flat Coat Rule
rules.body: Colour is applied as solid coats. No gradients, no transparency washes, no blur.

rules.name: The Readable Wall Rule
rules.body: Every text colour sits on a wall it was tested on. Izamal never letters on cal.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bungee is for signs, never for sentences. Anything read in full is Lexend.

rules.name: The Painted Shadow Rule
rules.body: The flat two-coat shadow belongs to display lettering only.

rules.name: The Overlap Rule
rules.body: Sections meet by overlapping coats (the band climbs 2rem onto the wall and stops short of the right edge), never by a gap with a divider.

rules.name: The Coats, Not Shadows Rule
rules.body: To raise something, paint it as a new coat over another wall; never lift it with a drop shadow.

rules.name: The Square Sign Rule
rules.body: No rounded corners and no pills, on anything.

dos: Do paint sections as whole flat walls (izamal, anil, enamel) on the cal ground.
Do keep almagre for the one chosen or pressed element.
Do letter the missing amount as boldly as the raised one.
Do outline tiles, boards and frames with the 2px enamel line and keep every corner square.
Do use tabular figures for every amount a donor reads.
Do keep touch targets large: tiles at least 3.25rem, the donate sign at least 3.75rem.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, pill buttons, gradients, blur or box shadows.
Don't put the painted shadow on anything other than display lettering.
Don't use almagre for decoration, headings or static emphasis.
Don't letter izamal on the cal ground; it fails contrast.
